login.intro:
Sign in with GitHub to upload and manage AppStore packages.
Package names are first-come, first-served: whoever first uploads a name owns it under their GitHub account,
and only the original uploader (or an admin) can update or unpublish that name afterwards.

upload.dropHtml:
Drag a .deb here, or click to choose a file
Parsed locally as soon as you pick it — nothing is uploaded yet
upload.networkFailed: Connection lost before the upload finished

preview.uploaderAs: Will be recorded as uploaded by @{login}
preview.needLogin: Please sign in with GitHub before submitting
preview.newPkg: New package name — after your first submission it belongs to you (@{login})
preview.newPkgAnon: New package name — after your first submission it belongs to you
preview.ownedBy: This package name is owned by @{login}; only they or an admin can update it
preview.versionTooLow: Version {version} is not higher than the published {latest}; please bump the version

pathHelp.title: Install paths rejected — how to fix them
pathHelp.rule: Debian's standard locations are all allowed; the one requirement is that whatever lands in a shared directory starts with your package's name, so an app cannot quietly take over a system command or another package's files. Separators are ignored when matching, so package fontpreview may use a font_preview directory.
pathHelp.hint: Paste the whole block below into an assistant (Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT). It carries the full policy plus the paths that were rejected, so it can fix your packaging scripts directly:
pathHelp.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text below manually

form.sourceRepoLabel: Source repository (optional, public repo; a store section in app-builder.json can auto-fill screenshots and other store info)
form.storeLegend: Store info (required; updating a published package prefills its current store data, which you can edit)
form.prefillNote: Prefilled with this package's current store info and screenshots — edit and submit.
form.authorName: Author display name (shown in store lists and detail pages)
form.shareCode: Share code (4 letters/digits, unique across the store; users type it on the device to jump to your app)
form.permissions: Permissions & runtime requirements (declare honestly; shown on the store page)
form.iconLabel: Icon (square PNG, auto-cropped to 256×256; updates keep the published icon by default)
form.hideEmail: Don't publicly show my email address (kept only for identity records; hidden by default — uncheck to publish your GitHub email)

mine.empty: No published packages found that belong to you
mine.note: The list combines the live APT index with your recent publish PRs and only shows packages that belong to you. A fresh submission first appears as "under review"; after merge the index takes a few minutes to rebuild. You can download published .deb files directly; unpublishing opens a removal PR.
mine.confirmUnpublish: Unpublish {name} {version}? This opens a removal PR.

decompress.loadFailed: Could not load the {what} decompression module (used only for local preview). Please refresh and retry; you can still submit — the server completes validation.

listing.title: Edit the store listing of {pkg}
listing.note: Updates only the name, description, categories, screenshots and icon shown in the store. No .deb is needed and the published version stays as it is. Merged automatically once the checks pass.
